text:
maria-partnerships: quick heads up — Satya's team on the HW marketplace asked for a clear rule when they should send minute-level events vs. hourly aggregates. they want to avoid double-billing on retries. :wave:

alex-platform: do we have a single recommended contract we can point them at? last time different partners were doing weird TTLs and we had to reconcile. :eyes:

tim-engr: we don't have a short doc, only the long playbook. my proposal: partners SHOULD send minute-level events only for real-time features and otherwise batch to hourly with an "aggregation_window": "hour" header. keep event ids stable so we can dedupe.

maria-partnerships: ok useful. can you paste a minimal webhook example we can share?

tim-engr: sure — minimal example below (JSON header + body)

```json
POST /usage HTTP/1.1
Host: ingest.redwood.ai
Authorization: Signature keyId=partner-123,signature="..."
Content-Type: application/json
X-Redwood-Aggregation: hour
X-Redwood-Idempotency-Key: partner-evt-20240214-0001

{
  "metering_source": "hw-embedded",
  "timestamp": "2024-02-14T15:00:00Z",
  "usage_units": 3600,
  "unit_type": "seconds",
  "external_event_id": "device-abc-0001"
}
```

maria-partnerships: perfect. also need guidance on backoff and expected HTTP semantics for partial ACKs / soft failures.

alex-platform: we should define explicit retry-after semantics and a partial-accept response. e.g., 202 Accepted with a body listing accepted range and rejected rows with error codes. reduces blind retries.

priya-sre: agreed. plus we should require an overall ingestion TTL: if event timestamp > 48h old, mark it as "stale" and return 410. that avoids late-arrival surprises.

jenna-fin: from billing side — any aggregation we accept needs to include a decomposition mapping so we can attribute credits to SKUs. e.g., include an array of {sku, units}. otherwise reconciliation is impossible.

tim-engr: good call. add optional `sku_breakdown` array. we will accept both minute and hourly if `X-Redwood-Aggregation` present, otherwise treat as raw event stream (will be rolled up by our ingestion).

maria-partnerships: what about clock drift and ordering? partners have devices with flaky clocks. we need stable dedupe key plus the timestamp. propose we accept `external_event_id` as primary dedupe and fallback to (device_id + timestamp).

alex-platform: and include `sequence_number` when possible. helps with monotonicity checks. also include `source_region` to route to correct ledger shard.

priya-sre: for spike protection, we should publish per-partner rate guidance and an explicit 429 response with `Retry-After`. also provide a backoff header: `X-Recommended-Batch-Size`.

maria-partnerships: i'm drafting a partner note. can you all comment on these bullets by EOD? i'll turn it into a short one-pager and example curl.

tim-engr: quick sanity check on reconciliation: we need partner to expose a daily reconciliation feed (compressed NDJSON) with total-per-sku for the day and a checksum. we will run weekly diffs and surface deltas to partner. also send an event-level sample on request.

jenna-fin: make sure the checksum is sha256 over canonical sorted lines, include UTC date header. finance will run matching and request adjustments.

maria-partnerships: adding that. last item — escrow credits for onboarding: partner can submit a small pre-paid bucket for first 48h to avoid billing delays; ops will refund unused.

priya-sre: i'll add the ingestion-level SLOs and our recommended burst tokens. also will wire `reconcile-bot` to post daily ingestion summaries to the partner channel.

reconcile-bot: Scheduled report will post to #partnerships/partner-ingest-summary at 06:00 UTC daily. will include accepted events, rejected rows, and top error codes.

maria-partnerships: sweet. next steps: tim to finalize contract example, priya to add SLOs, jenna to confirm checksum format, alex to prepare curl snippets. i'll publish on the partner portal once all thumbs up. :white_check_mark:

alex-platform: ack. i'll add a small test harness (curl + sample NDJSON) they can run.

jenna-fin: ack from billing. will validate our recon script against a synthetic partner feed.

priya-sre: ack, will bake it into the onboarding playbook.

maria-partnerships: thanks team — i'll send the partner note and tag everyone for review.

tim-engr: one more tiny thing — include example error responses: 400 (schema), 409 (duplicate), 410 (stale), 429 (rate), 202 (partial accept).

maria-partnerships: noted and added to draft. thanks!
